title: Polish Vegetable Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting Polish-inspired pilaf dish made with sautéed vegetables and served as a gluten-free option.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add chopped celery and sauté for another 2-3 minutes.
Add chopped carrots and sauté for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add uncooked rice and stir to combine with vegetables.
Pour in chicken broth, add herbs and paprika, salt and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
